name: @agentmemory/mcp

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Search stored memories and session observations for relevant context. Use when you need to recall what happened in previous sessions, find past decisions, or look up how a file was modified before.

format.description: Result format: full, compact, or narrative (default full)

token_budget.description: Optional estimated content token budget; response includes truncation and recovery metadata

targetLayer.description: Search all indexed layers (default), durable memories, or raw observations before ranking

agentId.description: Filter by owning agent; '*' reads across agents

tools.name: memory_save
tools.description: Explicitly save an important insight, decision, or pattern to long-term memory.

content.description: The insight or decision to remember

type.description: Memory type: pattern, preference, architecture, bug, workflow, or fact

project.description: Stable canonical project identifier this memory belongs to (e.g. a slug, UUID, or registry key). Must match the value used when the session was started. Do not use filesystem paths or ad-hoc display names — those change across machines and will silently break project scoping.

agentId.description: Agent identity to scope this memory to. When set, agent-scoped recall and search only surface it for the same agentId. Omit for shared memory.

tools.name: memory_sessions
tools.description: List recent sessions with status, observation counts, summaries and a continuation cursor. Filters apply before pagination; retain them when requesting the next page.

project.description: Exact project identifier used when sessions were started

agentId.description: Filter by owning agent; '*' reads across agents

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page

tools.name: memory_smart_search
tools.description: Hybrid semantic+keyword search with progressive disclosure. Pass query to search, or expandIds to recover full results.

expandIds.description: Comma-separated memory or observation IDs to expand; query is optional when provided

targetLayer.description: Search all indexed layers (default), durable memories, or raw observations before ranking

agentId.description: Filter by owning agent; '*' reads across agents

includeLessons.description: Include lesson matches when targetLayer is all (default true)

tools.name: memory_export
tools.description: Export memory data as JSON. Past the transport size limit the export is refused, so use the paging arguments on a large store.

collectionLimit.description: Rows per page for memories, summaries, graphNodes, lessons and the other top-level collections; access logs follow the memories on the page. Sessions and their observations are paged only by maxSessions and offset, so pass collections to leave them out of each page

collectionOffset.description: Row offset for the top-level collections

collections.description: Comma-separated collections to return, e.g. memories,lessons. Sessions and their observations come back only when the list names sessions, access logs only together with memories. Unknown names are ignored. Omit for everything. A paged or selected export cannot be imported with strategy replace.

tools.name: memory_audit
tools.description: View the audit trail of memory operations.

tools.name: memory_governance_delete
tools.description: Delete specific memories with audit trail.
